messages:
Maya Patel: Putting together launch gates for private deploy GA. Short checklist + callouts below, please review for missing items.
Samir Gupta: KMS is a hard ask from enterprise. Can we scope it as GA for enterprise and beta for self-serve?
Ashley Chen: Sales feedback: customers want key ownership. If it's GA only for enterprise tier that could work but we need clear docs.
Oliver Park: Also need explicit network profile docs: allowed ports, proxy envs, CIDR expectations, peering handshake behavior, and behavior under NAT.
Maya Patel: Initial compact gate list: 1) Installer supports offline bundle (air-gapped) OR documented beta path; 2) Customer-managed KMS integrated (cloud provider + KMIP HSM) or documented fallback; 3) Prometheus metrics + default scrape endpoint + retention guidance; 4) Deterministic upgrade with rollback script and db schema compatibility test; 5) Handshake/peering API + IP preservation guidance; 6) Operator UX for pinning models and canary rollouts; 7) Automated smoke e2e that loads a model and verifies routing policy.
Samir Gupta: Add key-rotation test: simulate rotation and assert zero inference errors for a 10m window. Infra will own harness.
Ashley Chen: Add logs retention and alerting defaults. And an explicit security checklist for KMS permission model.
Oliver Park: For upgrades: target <5% request loss, document network quiesce steps, and include steps for rollback to prior container+weights.
Maya Patel: Launch gate proposal: A) internal e2e pass; B) 2 pilot customers (one cloud-VPC peer, one air-gapped if possible) with signed success criteria; C) docs + runbooks in repo; D) security signoff on KMS and networking.
Ashley Chen: I'll own the air-gapped pilot outreach with CS. Need a templated install checklist to send.
Oliver Park: I'll recruit cloud-VPC pilot customers and own upgrade success metrics.
Samir Gupta: Infra will build the rotation test and test harness. Draft steps: rotate key, monitor for errors, validate 10m no-fail window, then rotate back.
Maya Patel: pkg-bot, can you generate a pilot install checklist link?
pkg-bot: Pilot checklist created: https://ci.redwood.internal/installer/checklists/2387654. Contains ports, env vars, smoke test commands.
Maya Patel: Action items:
- Maya: update gates with metrics + operator UX notes (due Tue)
- Samir: deliver test harness + rotation test plan (due Mon)
- Oliver: cloud pilot recruitment + upgrade metrics (due Wed)
- Ashley: air-gapped pilot outreach + templated checklist (due Fri)
- pkg-bot: keep checklist link current
Maya Patel: Tradeoff callout: we can ship GA earlier without air-gapped install (label as "air-gapped beta") which could save ~3 weeks. Need PM decision based on sales risk.
Ashley Chen: Sales says some deals will wait for air-gap. Call it out in tradeoff doc.
Maya Patel: I'll surface to PM leads today. Reopen thread for small edits. :thumbsup:
